changes: Ported from JavaScript to C#, on 2026-11-06, with the same tools, numbers and defaults. The interface now draws through ModSystem.ModifyInterfaceLayers, and photo mode switches the other layers off instead of blocking their draw. The UI Scale slider no longer shows its x suffix, which the C# config has no attribute for. The never-registered WorldSettingsUI (spawn rate and difficulty sliders) and other unreachable code were not ported.
